name: Howling Oak
summary: In the current era of 25 ADP, the Howling Oak does not exist within the night elven capital of Darnassus. While Darnassus flourishes atop Teldrassil as a haven for the kaldorei, Gilneas remains entirely sealed behind the Greymane Wall. Any rumors among travelers regarding a Gilnean settlement or a great worgen oak in northern Darnassus refer to events yet to pass.

sections.title: A Sealed Fate
sections.body: Presently in Darnassus, the northern reaches of the city do not house any tree known as the Howling Oak. The human kingdom of Gilneas lies far across the Great Sea, utterly locked away from the world behind the massive stone ramparts of the Greymane Wall. King Genn Greymane and his subjects turned their backs on the Alliance after the Second War, cutting off all diplomatic contact. The night elves of Teldrassil manage their grove, temples, and boughs without any Gilnean presence, focused instead on purifying their fledgling World Tree from corruption.

sections.title: Darnassus in the Present Era
sections.body: Visitors traveling between the Cenarion Enclave and the Craftsmen's Terrace will find only the pristine, tranquil forest and classic kaldorei architecture native to Teldrassil. Neither Gilnean refugees nor their druidic traditions have reached the shores of Kalimdor. Druidism in Darnassus remains the strict domain of the Cenarion Circle, who tend to nature under the watchful eyes of Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

faq.q: Where is the Howling Oak located?
faq.answer: You will not find the Howling Oak in Darnassus today. In 25 ADP, the northern canopy connecting the Craftsmen's Terrace and the Cenarion Enclave is unoccupied by foreign trees, as Gilneas remains sealed behind its southern wall across the sea.

faq.q: Are there Gilnean refugees in Darnassus?
faq.answer: No. The kingdom of Gilneas is fully isolated from the world behind the Greymane Wall, and no refugees or worgen inhabit the night elven capital in this era.

faq.q: What stands in this part of Darnassus right now?
faq.answer: The pathways in northern Darnassus connect the crafts and trade districts directly to the Cenarion Enclave, lined with native Teldrassil woodlands, quiet waters, and kaldorei structures rather than any foreign oak.

angles.text: Your capital of Darnassus remains an untainted sanctuary for the kaldorei, free from foreign refugees or the mysterious worgen curse.
All druidic instruction in Darnassus is conducted through the Cenarion Circle at the Cenarion Enclave, following ancient kaldorei traditions.
